distinctions: Input geometries were expanded from attributed COD CIF snapshots; they are not the previous independently constructed ideal prototypes.
Only the Skinner synthetic ZnS source is labelled an experimental measurement. Wyckoff handbook records do not invent measurement temperature or pressure.
A model-relaxed CIF descendant is distinct from the supplied source geometry. Source/model cells, volumes and deviations are retained.
Electronic temperature is fixed300K; phonon lattice temperatures are separate.
Sparse k/q meshes, finite AO cutoffs and volume-fit windows are measured diagnostics, not converged experimental predictions.
The original imaginary-mode, metallic-Berry, overlap-cutoff and out-of-window QHA failures are preserved.
QHA with fixed fractional internal coordinates and independently relaxed internal coordinates is separated; each uses its own consistently sampled static energies.
Native physical binary hashes remain the actual measured extension hashes. Later orchestration metadata corrections do not change measured numerical arrays.
